extracted.intended_audience: Arlington ISD community (students, parents), local residents, and school/event organizers
extracted.subtask_description: Planning and hosting high-school graduation ceremonies for a school district during COVID-19, including venue selection, scheduling, and health/safety measures to comply with state guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venue must meet TEA guidelines / be considered outdoor
rubrics_metrics.description: The stadium’s convertible roof makes the facility an outdoor venue that meets TEA guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When the district learned ceremonies couldn’t be held indoors, it sought an alternative that complied with Texas Education Agency (TEA) graduation procedures; selecting AT&T Stadium (with a convertible roof) made the facility qualify as an outdoor venue that met TEA guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strict safety protocols (health screenings and social distancing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Strict safety protocols will be in place for the ceremonies including health screenings and social distancing for all students and guests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AT&T Stadium will partner with Arlington ISD and the Arlington Fire Department to provide the safest graduation possible; protocols explicitly include health screenings and social distancing for attendees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide scheduled, separate ceremonies for each high school
rubrics_metrics.description: Each high school will have its own scheduled ceremony (dates and times listed for Lamar, Arlington High, Seguin, Martin, Arlington Collegiate, Bowie, and Sam Houston).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The announcement lists specific dates and times (June 5–7) for seven high schools, indicating a procedural requirement to stage separate ceremonies to accommodate students, families, and safety measures.
